Plain-text accounting for people who hate spreadsheets.

Ledger keeps your books in a single text file you can read, diff, and back up anywhere. No lock-in, no monthly fee, no dashboard you have to learn.

How it works

Record each transaction as two lines of text. Ledger balances them, totals your accounts, and prints a report you can hand to an accountant without apology. The file is yours forever, in a format that will outlive any app.

What you get

  • Double-entry bookkeeping in a format you can read by eye.
  • Reports: balance sheet, income statement, register, by account.
  • Works offline; syncs through whatever you already use for files.
  • Imports CSV from any bank; exports to CSV and PDF.

Pricing

One payment, sixty-eight dollars, every version forever. No subscription, because a text file does not need a server.

Made in Lisbon. Email hello@ledger.example for a copy.
